purpose: Train/validation subset contract for the 10-gesture demo dictionary that unblocks MODEL-02 / PW-09.

notes: The full Slovo dataset is about 16 GB and is intentionally not committed to this clean repository.
This manifest records reproducible source groups and split rules; local materialization must validate files against the Slovo archive before MODEL-02 / PW-09 training.

expected_contents: original or resized videos with non-gesture intervals

source.name: Slovo Russian Sign Language Dataset
source.attribution: Slovo Russian Sign Language Dataset and Models, hukenovs/slovo
source.modification_notes: Dataset content is not modified by this manifest. Future local materialization may copy selected clips under repo-local names only after checksum validation.

split_policy.train: Use Slovo annotations rows with train=True for the target label, sorted by attachment_id, excluding live smoke samples listed in live_smoke_relation.excluded_sample_ids.
split_policy.validation: Use Slovo annotations rows with train=False for the target label, sorted by attachment_id, excluding live smoke samples listed in live_smoke_relation.excluded_sample_ids.
split_policy.label_normalization: Only whitespace trim and lowercase for Slovo labels that differ only by capitalization, such as Пока and Плохо. Labels must not be manually remapped to a different word.

classes.label: _no_event

train.selection_rule: Select no-hand or pause windows outside annotated gesture intervals from legal Slovo original/360p videos; exclude any windows overlapping final_demo_dictionary gesture intervals.

validation.selection_rule: Use held-out users or train=False source videos for no-hand/pause windows; exclude live smoke videos and any gesture intervals.

classes.attribution: Slovo Russian Sign Language Dataset and Models, hukenovs/slovo
classes.modification_notes: Background windows must be derived locally from allowed non-gesture intervals. They are not committed in this PR because the required source archive is large and unavailable locally.
classes.runtime_reason: Current pose_words classifier labels include _no_event and runtime maps that label to no_result.

live_smoke_relation.relationship: Live smoke samples are excluded from train/validation materialization and are reserved as downstream e2e smoke inputs.

known_limitations: The full Slovo archive was not available in the local environment; this PR therefore commits a reproducible external-source manifest and report, not video files.
Class counts are target source-group counts for local materialization from Slovo annotations. They must be physically verified before MODEL-02 / PW-09 training.
_no_event is required by the current runtime label set but needs legal no-hand/pause windows from original or 360p Slovo sources; no fake background clips are committed.
Domain shift may remain between Slovo train/validation clips and live smoke samples from PR #77.
This task does not train a model, export artifacts, or change decoder thresholds.
